name: Matsuda
source:
A salesman. Excels at taking charge of situations and good at looking after others. A manly person who will undertake a challenge even if he must play the role of the bad guy. If there’s a dispute, he’ll settle it from one step away in true Japanese fashion. He’s aware of the fact that he looks older than his age. Loves to fish. Participating in the tour because he heard of the big catches to be had fishing on the island.

[Source: [URL=http://pilslash.jp/product/paradise/chara/?chara=3]official website profile[/URL].]
